title: salvia dorrii var. incana
intro: Salvia dorrii var. incana, commonly known as Incense Sage, is a plant species within the Salvia genus, characterized by its grayish-green foliage and small white to purple flowers. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Salvia dorrii var. incana are attributed to its calming and sedative effects, which may help alleviate anxiety and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
